assessment.scope: Two-round zero-context continuous reader review of complete B27 chapter (35,774 chars, 42 claims/endnotes, 2 comparison tables) in strict isolation without repository access.
assessment.findings: Confirmed clear progression from Dairy PEFCR to binding EU Batteries Regulation & ESPR, GHG Protocol vs Batteries accounting boundaries, assurance vs Notified Body Modules D1/G, corporate Scope 3 non-additivity, comparative assertion gates, and paywalled standard boundaries; verified first-occurrence Chinese glosses across all new prose and tables and crisp dedicated locators on Notes 28 and 29, concluding unconditional PASS (0 BLOCKER, 0 MAJOR, 0 MINOR).
answers: Distinguished non-binding TFEU Art. 288 Recommendation (EU) 2021/2279 from binding directly-applicable Regulations (EU) 2023/1542 and (EU) 2024/1781, showing how ESPR delegated acts convert voluntary PEF methods into statutory requirements and Digital Product Passports.

Contrasted GHG Protocol mandatory cradle-to-grave functional unit (final products) and non-attributable exclusions against Batteries Regulation Annex II 1 kWh functional unit, explicit use-phase exclusion, and 5-component plant-specific data with cross-plant sampling ban.

Separated first-/third-party limited & reasonable assurance from mandatory Notified Body conformity assessment (Modules D1/G, excluding Module A) and explained why product GHG sums do not equal corporate Scope 1+2+3 totals.

Explained why GHG Protocol does not support ISO 14044 comparative assertions (only 1 as-is use in Table A.2 p. 116) and recorded explicit open boundaries for paywalled ISO 14067 / ISO 14025 / EN 15804 / GB/T 24067 texts.
assessment.limits: Signs off Part VI chapter B27 only; B27 update, Part VI whole-part continuous reread, Parts VII-VIII, and all 8 global Programme #9 criteria remain open.
